claims.description: parse builds exactly the documented AST node shapes {t,v/name/items,line,col} for nums, strs, syms and nested lists, with list position at the opening paren
'x parses to a two-item list (quote x) whose position is the quote character's position
an unclosed ( raises WeftError at that paren's position with message starting 'unclosed (' and a stray ) raises WeftError at its position with message starting 'unexpected )'

tasks.description: Create src/parser.mjs with parse() per DESIGN.md section 3: consume tokenize() output into the exact node shapes of the spec (keys t, v/name/items, line, col), supporting any number of top-level forms and arbitrary nesting. Tests in tests/parser.test.mjs must deep-equal whole ASTs including positions.

Extend src/parser.mjs with the ' sugar per DESIGN.md sections 1 and 3: 'x becomes (quote x) with the synthesized list positioned at the quote character; works nested ('('a b) etc.). Tests in tests/parser-quote.test.mjs.

Extend src/parser.mjs with the two error contracts of DESIGN.md section 3 (unclosed ( at its own position, unexpected ) at its position, exact message prefixes). Tests in tests/parser-errors.test.mjs must assert message prefix AND line/col.
